svg.title: Fuse compared with dotnet build and dotnet test (fuse.codes)
svg.desc: Fuse, a faster .NET build and test loop for AI coding agents (fuse.codes, github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse). Check an edit, fuse check against dotnet build. FluentValidation (4 projects): 0.15 seconds with Fuse, 1.66 seconds with dotnet, 11.2x faster at the median; Fuse 0.07 to 7.90 s, mean 0.53 s, P95 1.06 s; dotnet 1.10 to 8.05 s, mean 2.24 s, P95 5.37 s; NodaTime (15 projects): 0.68 seconds with Fuse, 5.55 seconds with dotnet, 8.1x faster at the median; Fuse 0.07 to 17.8 s, mean 1.98 s, P95 10.3 s; dotnet 2.22 to 13.0 s, mean 6.13 s, P95 12.0 s; Jellyfin (40 projects): 0.83 seconds with Fuse, 23.0 seconds with dotnet, 27.7x faster at the median; Fuse 0.16 to 68.9 s, mean 6.68 s, P95 35.2 s; dotnet 3.73 to 93.1 s, mean 29.1 s, P95 85.1 s; Polly (15 projects): 2.90 seconds with Fuse, 28.7 seconds with dotnet, 9.9x faster at the median; Fuse 0.65 to 49.3 s, mean 7.54 s, P95 28.7 s; dotnet 4.25 to 116.4 s, mean 42.1 s, P95 114.4 s. Run the affected tests, fuse test against dotnet test. FluentValidation (2,664 tests): 9.66 seconds with Fuse, 11.9 seconds with dotnet, 1.2x faster at the median; Fuse 7.93 to 34.1 s, mean 13.8 s, P95 34.1 s; dotnet 11.3 to 18.3 s, mean 13.1 s, P95 18.3 s; NodaTime (42,736 tests): 57.7 seconds with Fuse, 41.7 seconds with dotnet, 1.4x slower at the median; Fuse 0.05 to 86.1 s, mean 52.4 s, P95 86.1 s; dotnet 32.6 to 68.1 s, mean 45.2 s, P95 68.1 s; Jellyfin (2,535 tests): 101.6 seconds with Fuse, 166.2 seconds with dotnet, 1.6x faster at the median; Fuse 4.64 to 144.5 s, mean 100.4 s, P95 144.5 s; dotnet 132.5 to 177.1 s, mean 164.0 s, P95 177.1 s; Polly (12,329 tests): 33.1 seconds with Fuse, 95.5 seconds with dotnet, 2.9x faster at the median; Fuse 0.05 to 109.5 s, mean 37.0 s, P95 109.5 s; dotnet 86.3 to 115.6 s, mean 99.7 s, P95 115.6 s. Check on a warm engine, fuse check, P50 / P95 over the edits of each kind. FluentValidation: Body edit 355 / 467 ms, Signature edit 3,968 / 12,487 ms, Nothing changed, P50 37 ms; NodaTime: Body edit 462 / 576 ms, Signature edit 2,382 / 5,858 ms, Nothing changed, P50 28 ms; Jellyfin: Body edit 127 / 1,288 ms, Signature edit 58 / 36,770 ms, Nothing changed, P50 27 ms; Polly: Body edit 206 / 247 ms, Signature edit 913 / 9,400 ms, Nothing changed, P50 44 ms. Accuracy against the real build and test run, Counted against dotnet build and dotnet test on the same edits. FluentValidation: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 8 changes; NodaTime: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 7 changes; Jellyfin: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 2 changes; Polly: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 1 of 7 changes. Engine memory, Working set of the engine process. FluentValidation: After the checks 732 MB, Peak 738 MB, Idle 512 MB; NodaTime: After the checks 374 MB, Peak 729 MB, Idle 319 MB; Jellyfin: After the checks 443 MB, Peak 937 MB, Idle 423 MB; Polly: After the checks 548 MB, Peak 1,091 MB, Idle 504 MB. Median times over the eval cases, each with the range from the fastest to the slowest case, the mean and P95, on GitHub Actions windows-latest runners.
